data.narrative: Devanshi demonstrated exceptional proficiency in performance debugging and profiling. Using memory and CPU profiling tools rather than static code reading, diagnosed an unclosed connection pool leak on error paths, identified a silent N+1 query regression caused by an ORM dependency update, and resolved catastrophic regular expression backtracking (ReDoS) on the URL validator.

dimension_scores.observation: Formulated precise hypotheses attributing connection pool exhaustion to unhandled error branches, /links degradation to N+1 query multiplication, and CPU freeze to catastrophic regex backtracking.
dimension_scores.evidence: Tested hypotheses empirically via scripts/drill-module-04-performance.ts and scripts/drill-redos-profiler.ts.

dimension_scores.observation: Interpreted database query logs and heap metrics accurately, isolating 51 serial queries on /links and flat 1.08MB post-fix heap memory.
Built reproducible benchmarking harnesses simulating 2,000 requests under 2% error rates and exponential backtracking across string lengths.
Documented performance trade-offs clearly, contrasting manual profiling and APM, and detailing root-cause mechanics for production stakeholders.
Identified the root architectural flaw in try-catch without finally, recognized ORM version default shift, and analyzed O(2^n) state space exploration in regex engine.
Established long-term preventative controls: connection release in finally, query count assertion tests in CI, and replacing regex validation with WHATWG URL parsing.

strengths: Tool-driven runtime observability over subjective code reading
Deep understanding of V8 event loop blocking via ReDoS
Comprehensive empirical verification under high request volume
data.recommendation: Advance to Module 05 for incident management, severity triage, and stakeholder communication under high-pressure outages.

public_evidence.reviewer_value: Shows mastery of runtime performance analysis, heap inspection, query plan optimization, and algorithmic complexity mitigation.
